name: bld5_card_orderOf_eq_larger_prime_of_card_prime_mul_prime
statement: (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p < q) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) : Nat.card {g : G // orderOf g = q} = q - 1
closed: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p < q) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a), Nat.card {g : G // orderOf g = q} = q - 1
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld4_card_orderOf_eq_prime_of_card_prime_mul_prime: every element has order dividing pq, i.e. in {1, p, q, pq}; order pq is impossible since then G is cyclic (isCyclic_of_orderOf_eq_card) hence commutative. Partition G by order: pq = 1 + q(p−1) + #{order q}, where q(p−1) is the bld4 count of elements of order p; so #{order q} = pq − 1 − q(p−1) = q − 1.
type: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)], Nat.Prime q → p < q → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p * q → (∃ a b, a * b ≠ b * a) → Nat.card { g // orderOf g = q } = q - 1
